items.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: And then him and I became very good friends and I would go up to his house to get the data for an orchestration that I was going to do for him and his small group

ctx.x: And it wasn’t even like official lessons, it was just like on the job, right?

Oh no, it was just — here’s how you do this Al. And I would do it like that. Because like I used to love Teddy Wilson and I used to actually start playing similar to him. And then him and I became very good friends and I would go up to his house to get the data for an orchestration that I was going to do for him and his small group down at — what is it called, it was — well anyhow, he was in the bathroom shaving or something and I was playing the piano and he sticks his head out and he says, “You’ve been…
